sections.description: Integration between WordPress and Bottle360 e-commerce APIs.
sections.changelog:
What's new in 4.5.22
- Customers who are already signed in no longer see the Sign In form again when they come back to it from another page. They go straight to their account.
- Refreshing the store, or opening a saved link to it, while on page 2 or later of the product list no longer shows a "Page not found" error.
- Signing in partway through checkout no longer gets stuck at "Save a billing address before saving a card." The customer is asked to confirm their billing address and can finish the order.
- The Styling Studio now shows the Apple Pay button next to Google Pay, so you can see how both will look at checkout.
